name: OnchainKit
description: Coinbase-maintained React component library and toolkit for building Base-native consumer apps and Farcaster miniapps. Provides pre-built UI components for wallets, transactions, identity (Basenames), and Farcaster Frames.

ecosystem_fit.notes: Maintained by Coinbase. The default UI and interaction toolkit for Base consumer applications.
Has dedicated Frames SDK integration. Key tool in Farcaster miniapp stacks.
Works on Ethereum but components are Base-opinionated. Less useful outside Base context.

common_pairings.context: Privy handles wallet creation and auth; OnchainKit provides the React UI components that wrap the wallet. The dominant Base consumer app combination.
Neynar for Farcaster social data, OnchainKit for the Frame and UI layer.
Alchemy as the RPC provider under OnchainKit's transaction components.

trust_evidence.description: Maintained by Coinbase/Base team. Dominant UI toolkit in Base ecosystem.
Privy + OnchainKit is the most consistently cited Base consumer app pattern in the corpus and WORKFLOWS.md.
Maintained by the Coinbase Base team. Official Coinbase product — strong shipping track record.

scale_guidance.hackathon: Fastest path to a working Base app with wallet, transaction, and identity UI.
scale_guidance.production: Opinionated components reduce custom design flexibility. If product requires heavy custom UI, consider using OnchainKit's core logic hooks without its UI components.

alternatives.when_to_prefer: When OnchainKit's opinionated UI components are too restrictive and custom design is required. wagmi provides the underlying hooks without enforced UI.

anti_patterns: Using OnchainKit for Solana or non-EVM chains — it is Base/Ethereum-specific.
Treating OnchainKit as a wallet provider — it is a UI layer. It wraps Privy, Coinbase Wallet SDK, or other wallet providers.
Using OnchainKit components in production without understanding their Base-opinionated assumptions around chain ID and network.

sdk_migration.notes: @coinbase/onchainkit is actively maintained at v1.1.2 with no package rename and no formal version deprecation. The 0.x → 1.x transition added subpath exports incrementally.
